segments.text: 你有没有见过那种“预测未来”的小游戏？
听起来很神秘，其实说得很
mysterious prediction meets ordinary family emergency
第一帧，先看乡村集市和算命帐篷。
中文锚点是：在一个乡村
At a village fair, I decided to visit a fortune-teller called Madam Bellinsky
不是商场，也不是展销会，而是乡村里的热闹活动，有小摊、游戏、食物、帐篷和娱乐。
也要当作集市娱乐，不要把她讲成真的有魔力。
接着主人公走进她的帐篷：
she told me to sit down
old fair, curious visitor, fortune-teller tent
第二帧，看水晶球里的模糊预言。
中文锚点是：我给了她一些钱之后，她看着
After I had given her some money, she looked into a crystal ball
After I had given her some money
说明先给钱，然后她才看水晶球。
A relation of yours is coming to see you
She will be arriving this evening and intends to stay for a few days
接着她把气氛说得更神秘：
The moment you leave this tent, you will get a big surprise
A woman you know well will rush towards you
prediction sounds personal, but the words are still vague
第三帧，普通生活突然接上了预言。
中文锚点是：我一走到外面，就把
忘了，因为妻子急匆匆向我走来。
As soon as I went outside, I forgot all about Madam Bellinsky
because my wife hurried towards me
妻子很着急，但不是可怕地生气，只是他们已经赶时间了。
这句话不是说主人公真的藏起来了，而是很不耐烦地问：你到底去哪儿了？
the vague woman becomes his wife, and mystery turns into daily hurry
第四帧，看这个“预言”为什么像是应验了。
不到一小时就到，他们必须去
Your sister will be here in less than an hour
是不到一小时，立刻有了紧急感。
we must be at the station to meet her
最后主人公跟着妻子离开了
As she walked away, I followed her out of the fair
the future sounds mysterious, but the explanation is everyday life
第一感觉好像准，但我们要看它是不是
可以是很多家人，后来刚好套上了
mysterious words meet ordinary family life
Exactly. The language sounds like magic, but the answer is hurry, sister, station, and being late
At a village fair, I decided to visit a fortune-teller called Madam Bellinsky.
I went into her tent and she told me to sit down.
After I had given her some money, she looked into a crystal ball and said: 'A relation of yours is coming to see you.
She will be arriving this evening and intends to stay for a few days.
The moment you leave this tent, you will get a big surprise.
A woman you know well will rush towards you.
She will speak to you and then she will lead you away from this place. That is all.'
As soon as I went outside, I forgot all about Madam Bellinsky because my wife hurried towards me.
'Where have you been hiding?' she asked impatiently.
'Your sister will be here in less than an hour and we must be at the station to meet her. We are late already.'
As she walked away, I followed her out of the fair.
在这一课里是乡村集市。
它不是现代展会，而是本地活动：小摊、帐篷、游戏、食物和娱乐。
是故事的舞台，轻松、热闹、带一点旧式趣味。
，就准备进入一个轻松的集市娱乐场景。
是声称能预测未来的人。
但在这篇课文里，她更像
我们学习的是故事笑点，不是相信
这个词很重要，因为它听起来
A relation of yours is coming to see you
怎样制造神秘感，又怎样回到日常安排。
you will get a big surprise
She will be arriving this evening
它像一个安排好的到达，后来妻子说
不到一小时就来，变成真实日程。
Intends to stay for a few days
就是打算住几天，比简单说
The moment you leave this tent
As soon as I went outside
两个短语都表示动作马上接上。
After I had given her some money, she looked into a crystal ball
的日常问法：你到底去哪儿了？
，就能听出妻子为什么这么急。
放到一个安全的现代场景：
学校活动上，你试了一个
来看你，你一离开教室就会有
结果你一走到外面，妈妈就急匆匆向你走来。
不到一小时就到，你们必须赶快回家。
好像很准，其实只是普通事情套上了
At a school fair, I decided to try a prediction app
It said a relation of mine would be arriving soon
The moment I left the classroom, I would get a big surprise
As soon as I went outside, my mother hurried towards me
The prediction sounded mysterious, but it was just a funny coincidence
